title: Invio Desktop Invoicing Software
description: Invio Desktop Invoicing Software by Timrio is a free, privacy-first offline billing and inventory management application for Windows and macOS. Create GST and standard invoices in seconds, print 58mm and 80mm thermal receipts with dynamic UPI payment QR codes, scan barcodes for quick checkout, track inventory with low-stock alerts, and manage customer credit ledgers. Business records are stored 100% locally on your computer in SQLite with zero cloud dependency and zero telemetry.
